## Description and Rationale

Helios One Oy is a Helsinki-based AI company building agents and software for factories. Single-member team: Touko Ursin (co-founder; GitHub ToukoUrsin). We registered to apply our operational-prediction work (gradient-boosted models with careful time-based validation) to taxi-out time prediction, benchmark it on open aviation data, and publish a reproducible open-source (GPLv3) solution.

## Details

* Type: Industry
* Country: Finland
* Number of team members: 1
